name: Jinlongyu Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jinlongyu Group Co., Ltd. engages in research and development, production, sale, and service of wires and cables in China and internationally. It offers ow-smoke halogen-free wires and cables, low-smoke halogen-free flame-retardant wires and cables, fire-resistant low-smoke halogen-free wires and cables, fire-resistant wires and cables, flame-retardant wires and cables, high-performance aluminum alloy wires and cables, waterproof cables, termite-proof cables, and branch cables. Jinlongyu Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
